get_json_scenarios_by_language: get JSON scenarios for a given language filtered by name regex and category
get_json_scenarios_all_categories: get all JSON scenarios for a language without filtering by category
get_json_scenarios_regex_filter: get JSON scenarios matching a specific name pattern using regex
dump_to_json_files: dump a list of JSON scenarios to individual files with a custom prefix
dump_to_json_files_default_prefix: dump JSON scenarios to files using the default scenario_dump_ prefix
